INTRO DATE
APRIL 1b, Lats
ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance be amended by changing all the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols
and

indications as shown on Map No. 11-L in the area bounded by

The alley next north of and parallel to West Irving Park Road;
a line 108.60 feet east of and parallel to North LaPorte Avenue;
West Irving Park Road; and North Laporte Avenue,

to those of a B3-3 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 4916-4924 West Irving Park Road
